subject: maths
question: Rahul runs at a speed of 6 km/h in a 100-metre race. Rahul gives Bharat a start of 4 metres and still beats him by 4 seconds. Find Bharat’s speed.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Speed of Rahul in 100 metre race is 6 km/h 

Rahul gives Bharat a 4 m start and beats him by 4 seconds

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**CALCULATION:**

Speed of Rahul = 6 km/h = 6 × (5/18) = 5/3 m/s [1m/s = km/h × 5/18]

Time taken by Rahul to complete 100 m race = Distance/ Speed 

⇒ 100 /(5/3) = 60 seconds

Time taken by Bharat to complete = 60 + 4 = 64 seconds

Distance covered by Bharat = 100 - 4 = 96m

Speed of Bharat = 96/64 m/s

⇒( 96/64) × 18/5 = 5.4 km/h

** Hence, Speed of Bharat is 5.4 km/h.**
